notes:
The project word count in the tab bar is right again. Saving a chapter recorded its length as zero, so "Project: 0 / 80000" stayed at zero until the project was reopened, and with a folder selected the open chapter was counted twice.

Grammar checking recovers on its own. After a long session LanguageTool could stop answering while Corylus still called it ready, so every check quietly timed out. Corylus now notices, restarts it, and carries on.

Comparing a snapshot shows only what changed in your text. It used to list the bookkeeping at the top of the file as well, so a revision counter showed up as a change before any prose did.

The continuous view looks like the editor: same font, size and typography preset, and each chapter's title between the chapters.

Smaller fixes: backups made in the same second no longer overwrite each other and keep their own label; context menus close with Escape; turning on a sentence-structure check marks existing text straight away; the section type in the Inspector is translated; and the comments hint shows Ctrl+Shift+M on Windows instead of the Mac keys.

You can restore a backup from inside Corylus: Settings > Snapshots & Backups lists them, and Restore puts the one you pick in a new folder wherever you choose. The screen for this existed but nothing led to it, and its button could not have worked anyway - it handed the restore a file name where it needed a path. A restore never writes over files that are already there.

The README-corylus.txt in every project told you the .corylus folder was a search index, safe to delete. It holds your snapshots and your comments, so following that advice would have lost both. The file now says what the folder really holds and where the backups really go, and Corylus corrects the old text in your projects the next time you open them - unless you edited it, in which case it is yours.

A relationship can carry both of its names from the start. When you add one, a second field asks what the other entry calls it - "creator of" from Victor, "created by" from the Creature. Leave it empty and both sides show the same name, as before.
